description:
Upstream's `app.editor.external` (Ctrl+G) opens the user's $EDITOR (or $VISUAL) with the current input text in a temp file. When the editor exits, the content is loaded back into the input. Uses the terminal's alternate screen so the TUI is preserved.

Our Interactive has no external editor support.

Implement:
1. On Ctrl+G, write current input to a temp file.
2. Exit raw mode, spawn $EDITOR/$VISUAL with the temp file, wait for it to exit.
3. Read the temp file back, set as input text.
4. Re-enter raw mode, re-render.

Ref: `interactive-mode.ts` L3395-3430.
title: Interactive: external editor support (Ctrl+G)
